data: Does the red line representing the BERT accuracy always decrease as the qth percentile on the x-axis increases?

The red line representing the BERT accuracy does not always decrease as the qth percentile on the x-axis increases. In both graphs, the BERT accuracy initially remains relatively stable or slightly decreases as the qth percentile increases until around the 80th percentile. After this point, there is a sharp decline in the BERT accuracy. Therefore, the statement is not entirely accurate.
